title: Impact of Chemical Quality on High-Throughput in Vitro Assays: A Tox21 Study.
authors: Ngan, Deborah K; Ye, Lin; Hsieh, Jui-Hua; Xu, Tuan; Zhao, Jinghua; Sakamuru, Srilatha; Tao, Dingyin; LeClair, Christopher A; Zhao, Tongan; Rossoshek, Anna; Reif, David M; Simeonov, Anton; Xia, Menghang; Huang, Ruili
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Tox21化学库的质量控制与稳定性预测，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The Tox21 10K chemical library, an in vitro toxicology toolbox consisting of more than 8900 unique chemical entities including environmental chemicals and drugs, has undergone analytical quality control (QC) testing after storage at room temperature for 0 and 4 months (T0 and T4). Each chemical was previously assigned a QC grade based on purity, identity, and concentration. In parallel, the Tox21 10K library has been tested across approximately 90 in vitro assays in a quantitative high-throughput screening (qHTS) format, generating >120 M data points to date. These data were used to analyze the correlation between chemical quality and bioassay activity, as well as chemical structure. The chemical characteristics of poor-quality and unstable compounds were explored to identify structural features that should be avoided. In addition, one of the high-throughput assays measuring the induction of p53 activity by small molecules was used to test the Tox21 10K compound library at T0 and T4 due to its robust performance and reproducibility. Approximately 2% of compounds in the library showed a significant change in activity in the p53 assay between T0 and T4 (active to inactive or vice versa), which also correlated with chemical stability. Here, machine learning models were constructed using bioassay data or chemical structures to predict poor-quality (low QC grades at T0) and unstable (grade drop from T0 to T4) chemicals. Chemical structure was found to be highly predictive (0.75) of chemical quality and stability, whereas bioassay data was less predictive (0.66) but still showed better than random performance. Taken together, these findings provide valuable guidance for interpreting the Tox21 assay results and informing best practices for future chemical selection and handling.
abstract_zh: Tox21 10K化学库，一个包含超过8900种独特化学实体（包括环境化学品和药物）的体外毒理学工具箱，在室温下储存0个月和4个月（T0和T4）后，已进行了分析质量控制（QC）测试。每种化学品先前根据纯度、身份和浓度被分配了一个QC等级。与此同时，Tox21 10K库已在约90种体外试验中以定量高通量筛选（qHTS）格式进行了测试，迄今已生成超过1.2亿个数据点。这些数据用于分析化学质量与生物测定活性以及化学结构之间的相关性。探索了低质量和不稳定化合物的化学特性，以识别应避免的结构特征。此外，由于p53活性诱导的高通量测定具有稳健的性能和可重复性，其中一个用于测量小分子诱导p53活性的高通量测定被用于在T0和T4时测试Tox21 10K化合物库。库中约2%的化合物在p53测定中显示T0和T4之间的活性显著变化（从活性变为非活性或反之），这也与化学稳定性相关。在此，利用生物测定数据或化学结构构建了机器学习模型，以预测低质量（T0时QC等级低）和不稳定（从T0到T4等级下降）的化学品。发现化学结构对化学质量和稳定性的预测性较高（0.75），而生物测定数据的预测性较低（0.66），但仍优于随机表现。综上所述，这些发现为解释Tox21测定结果和指导未来化学品选择与处理的最佳实践提供了宝贵指导。
